task.title: Installing Coverity Connect
task.shortdesc: A quick brief guide on the steps required to install Coverity Connect

context.p: The following will provide steps on how to install Coverity connect. After the installation you are able to install IDE plug ins for Coverity for a varitys of differnet IDEs.

ul.li: Are you using an embedded or external database?
Check your current hardware with the Coverity hardware requiremnts found in the deployment planning documents.
Database administrator must alter file settings for the requiements of your systems.

step.cmd: Before installing always verify that the enviroment meets the requirments.
Download Coverity Platform Installer onto your OS inoder to install Coverity Connect.
Coverity Connect server software can run on Windows and linux if you choose not to run Coverity Connect as a service.
Run the follwing script or program for your system

ul.li: Select database type and enter the requeired information
Continue to follow set up steps and enter information requested

step.info: Launch Coverity Connect with one of the urls

taskbody.postreq: If in need of any assistance please visit the online documentation available at Black Ducks Documentation.
